note: Which Windows executables of a release archive get an Authenticode signature. Paths are relative to the archive's top folder; '*' stays inside one folder, '**' crosses folders; matching ignores case. A PE file that matches no entry and carries no signature of its own fails the signing run, so a new binary needs a decision here. 'required_in_player' lists the signed files that every extracted player folder must contain (each must also match an entry of 'sign'); tools/release/verify_signatures.ps1 fails when one is missing.

never_sign.reason: the patched engine's SHA-256 is the engine pin (tools/engine_pins.json); signing it needs a pin change of its own
